# Acme (shadcn/ui)

An invented design system built the shadcn/ui way, for `test/shadcn.test.mjs`: components copied into
`src/components/ui`, styled with Tailwind 4, variants written with class-variance-authority, behaviour from Radix,
and the `@/` alias set in `components.json`, `tsconfig.json` and `vite.config.ts`. Its packages are the ones
`test/.react-tools` installs, linked in by the test. Every name is invented.
